skillSays: Fetch Vercel's current Web Interface Guidelines and check the UI file against every rule, reporting terse file:line findings
Accessibility basics: labels on every control, semantic button/a, aria-hidden on decorative icons, aria-live for async updates, skip link, heading order
Focus: never remove outlines without a :focus-visible replacement; compound controls use :focus-within
Forms: autocomplete, correct type/inputmode, no blocked paste, inline errors, focus the first error, placeholders end with an ellipsis
Typography and motion: curly quotes, real ellipsis, non-breaking spaces, tabular-nums, balanced headings, no transition: all, honour prefers-reduced-motion
Content and state: Title Case headings and buttons, specific button labels, Intl number formatting, URL reflects state

changes: Heading and button copy converted to Title Case ('Start Your Free Trial', 'See How It Works') and specific labels kept instead of 'Learn more'
Added a skip link, balanced headings (text-wrap: balance), tabular-nums on the schedule times and aria-hidden on all decorative icons
Brand name wrapped in translate="no" and a non-breaking space in '6 min'; every transition lists its properties instead of 'transition: all'
Added color-scheme and theme-color meta, :focus-visible rings, touch-action: manipulation and a prefers-reduced-motion block
Billing toggle state is mirrored in the URL (#yearly) and restored on load, per the 'URL reflects state' rule
Prices rendered with Intl.NumberFormat ($15.20, $1,238.40) and tabular-nums instead of hand-built strings
Toggle is a labelled fieldset of radios with an aria-live=polite status line announcing the price change
Headings and CTAs in Title Case with distinct labels ('Start With Solo', 'Start With Clinic'); transitions list explicit properties
Every input got a matching autocomplete, name and type/inputmode; email and password set spellcheck=false and paste is never blocked
Placeholders end with an ellipsis and show an example pattern ('maya@sunrisephysio.com...'); the select has an explicit background colour for dark OS themes
Errors sit inline next to each field in an aria-live=polite region, tell the user how to fix the problem, and the first invalid field gets focus on submit
Submit stays enabled and switches to 'Creating Account...' during the request; a beforeunload guard warns about unsaved edits; password toggle uses :focus-within
